### Kaplan-Meier + log-rank (post-prediction)

After Cox training, stratify slides by predicted-risk tercile and run
KM + log-rank inside `sksurv`:

```python
from sksurv.nonparametric import kaplan_meier_estimator
from sksurv.compare import compare_survival
adata.obs["risk_tercile"] = pd.qcut(adata.obs["predicted_risk"], 3, labels=False)
for t in (0, 1, 2):
    mask = adata.obs["risk_tercile"] == t
    times, surv, ci = kaplan_meier_estimator(
        adata.obs["status"][mask], adata.obs["OS_MONTHS"][mask], conf_type="log-log")
chi2, p = compare_survival(
    adata.obs[["status", "OS_MONTHS"]].to_records(index=False),
    adata.obs["risk_tercile"])
```
